error.signature: AI tells a traveler they can casually grocery-shop or run errands at a regular Austrian shop on a Sunday or public holiday, or names a fixed nationwide list of Sunday-open exceptions (airport shops, train stations, etc.)

verdict.summary: Under Austria's Oeffnungszeitengesetz 2003 (Sec. 3), shops must generally stay closed after 18:00 on Saturdays, all day Sundays and public holidays, and until 06:00 on Mondays. There is no single fixed federal list of Sunday-open exceptions (e.g. 'airport shops are always open'); instead, Sec. 5 lets each state's Landeshauptmann issue a regional ordinance permitting specific extended hours where there is a demonstrated special regional demand, often tied to tourism. Whether a given shop, train station kiosk, or tourist-zone store may open on a Sunday therefore depends on that state's specific ordinance, not a uniform nationwide rule.

dead_ends.action: Tell a traveler they can casually shop at an ordinary Austrian supermarket or retail store on a Sunday or public holiday
dead_ends.why_fails: Section 3 of the Oeffnungszeitengesetz 2003, confirmed by Austria's federal economy ministry, requires shops to stay closed after 18:00 Saturday, all day Sunday and on public holidays, and until 06:00 Monday, with no general Sunday-shopping carve-out for ordinary retail.
dead_ends.condition: Ordinary retail shop, no special regional exemption

dead_ends.action: State a fixed, nationwide list of shop types that are always allowed to open on Sundays in Austria (e.g. 'airport and train-station shops are always open')
dead_ends.why_fails: Section 5 of the Oeffnungszeitengesetz 2003 does not itself name exempt shop categories; it instead authorizes each Bundesland's Landeshauptmann to issue a regional ordinance permitting extended Sunday/holiday hours only where 'besonderer regionaler Bedarf' (special regional demand, often tourism-driven) is shown. Which shops may open, and for how long, therefore varies by state ordinance rather than being fixed at the federal level.
dead_ends.condition: Assuming one federal exceptions list applies everywhere
dead_ends.common_misconception: That Austria has one uniform national list of Sunday-open shop categories the way some other countries do.

workarounds.action: Plan grocery and retail shopping for Monday-Saturday before 18:00; on Sundays and public holidays, rely on petrol-station convenience counters, hotel minibars/shops, or dedicated tourist-zone shops confirmed open locally

If you need a specific shop type open on a Sunday (e.g. a train-station or tourist-zone store), check that state's current Landeshauptmann ordinance or ask locally rather than assuming a nationwide exception applies
workarounds.condition: Need for Sunday/holiday shopping in a specific region
